newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank down after units merge.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank down after units merge.

text.p: Investors continued selling Thai Military Bank Plc after the Thai bourse allowed it to resume trading on Thursday afternoon after briefly halting business in the counter earlier, brokers said.

Thai Military Bank slipped 2.25 baht to 36.75 baht at 0925 GMT after resumption of trading. Late on Thursday, Thai Military's subsidiaries Nava Finance and Securities Plc and Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc announced they had merged with CMIC Finance and Securities.
"Thai Military Bank is normally not active in the market as it has thin liquidity," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.
The bank is sixth-ranked in the country in terms of assets and most of its shares are owned by Thai military officials.
"I think investors will probably stay away from Thai Military Bank while the market is in doldrums," said Bunsom.
